$comment: cmux.agentPane.style/1: the CSS custom properties a person's agent-pane/theme.css (and a look add-on's) may set, on :root only. They are paint: color, fill, edge and corner. None moves a box, so a look applied or hot reloaded never shifts the transcript. Type, width and spacing are settings (agentPane.display.*), because the transcript's height estimate reads them (model.ts); a stylesheet that set them would make rows jump when they are measured. The colors the host pushes from the theme (--agent-text, --agent-accent and the rest of shared/theme.ts cssVariables) are inline styles on the root, so a stylesheet cannot beat them: set those with the theme file's `colors` and `appearance.surfaces.agentPane`. webviews scripts/check-look-addons.ts holds the pane's stylesheets and every add-on in examples/looks to this file: each token is declared on :root in `owner` (or, for a token with no value of its own, read there with a fallback: `var(--token, today's value)`), nowhere else but `alsoScopedIn`, never pushed by the host, and an add-on sets nothing else. Docs: docs/cmux-next/look-addons.md.
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first outside look before the interface is public

tokens.name: --cv-text
tokens.about: The transcript's body text: prompts, replies and headings.

tokens.name: --cv-text-muted
tokens.about: Secondary transcript text: meta lines, the live run's words. Tool rows and Worked for draw --cv-activity-text.

tokens.name: --cv-activity-text
tokens.about: Background activity: tool rows and Worked for (58% of the text by default). A look on a light paper of its own sets it, often to its --cv-text-muted, to hold 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --cv-text-dim
tokens.about: The quietest transcript text: timestamps and hints.

tokens.name: --cv-activity-text
tokens.about: Tool-call rows, Worked for, notices and background activity lines. Unset: the theme's secondary ink, --agent-muted (Instrument's ink.activity), which holds 4.5:1 on every fill.

tokens.name: --agent-link
tokens.about: Links in the rest of the pane (chips, cards, the composer).

tokens.name: --cv-card-fill
tokens.about: The fill of the card level in the pane: tool output, edit, error and permission cards, plans, the subagent card (design/chat-surfaces.md). Code blocks keep --cv-codeblock-bg. Unset: the card level, the theme's text at 4%.

tokens.name: --cv-card-ring
tokens.about: The hairline around those cards (none under appearance.borders: none). Unset: the card level's line, the theme's text at 10%.

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-tint
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's glass tint. Unset: the theme's text at 14%.

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-edge
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's hairline edge. Unset: none (transparent).

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-radius
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's corner radius. Unset: 12 px at the chat's text scale. A corner never changes the bubble's box.

tokens.name: --cv-code-edge-fade
tokens.about: How far a code block's long line fades at the card's right edge while more of it lies past. Unset: no fade, a hard edge. Paint only: the line's box does not change.
